study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled treatment trial
outcome: Composite of birth before 37 weeks' gestation
cohort: Pregnant women with risk factors for gestational diabetes, diagnosed with early or late GDM, who did not receive early GDM treatment.
finding: Adverse perinatal outcomes were significantly increased in women with early gestational diabetes mellitus (EGDM) despite treatment initiated from 24-28 weeks' gestation, suggesting the need for earlier and more aggressive treatment.
mod_finding: Induction of labor was higher in both the early GDM and late GDM groups compared to control participants.
followup_time: Within the neonatal period (up to 28 days post-birth)
